messages:
maya: Quick check — we have a small wave of dependent PRs blocked on api#452 (schema change). SDK, console, and helm updates are queued. Planning a short merge window tomorrow morning. Who can review/own which piece?
liam: I can take the SDK PR (github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/789). Free until 15:00 PT today. Any risky breaking fields?
sam: I skimmed the API diff — added optional field `model_hint` and left default behavior untouched. Console needs a defensive UI change though (ignore unknown keys). I can do that.
zhou: Helm/runtime note: runtime needs kv-cache flag toggled and image bump for the sdk-proxy. I'll open chart bump PR (charts/runtime#33) and link the image tag.
maya: @liam thanks. If we merge SDK first, console will still call old endpoints for a bit — maybe better to land API -> SDK -> Console? Thoughts? :thinking_face:
liam: Prefer API -> SDK -> Console. SDK could validate payloads from api, so if API ships first we don't get unexpected shapes. Also helps e2e gating.
nina: I can watch API CI + canary and approve on green. Will you add a short smoke test?
sam: adding a smoke e2e: `yarn test:e2e --filter=pr-452-smoke` — will push in a minute. Also I'll gate console UI behind a feature flag so it won't render `model_hint` until backend advertises.
dev-bot: Deployment job queued: `api-canary/staging` — job id 6721. Logs: https://ci.redwood/6721
ops-bot: Heads-up: merge window tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT. Use #release-slack during the window and follow the rollback checklist if needed.
maya: Plan summary: API (nina) merges at 10:00 — monitor canary + CI. SDK (liam) merges at ~10:20 after API is green. Helm/runtime + console (zhou + sam) at ~10:40 with chart bump and feature-flag off by default. I'll coordinate. :thumbsup:
liam: I'll queue SDK tests to start right after API green. If anything flakey, revert API with `git revert <sha>` and rollback helm to `image.tag=v1.2.9`.
zhou: I'll include the chart values snippet in the PR description: ```
values:
  runtime:
    image:
      tag: pr-789-sdk-proxy
    kvCache:
      enabled: true
```
ops-bot: Runbook link created: https://confluence.redwood/crossrepo/pr-wave-1749994321 — includes rollback steps and contact list.
maya: Perfect. If anyone cannot attend the window ping here and we'll replan. Otherwise I'll post final checklist 1h before.
liam: :eyes: will confirm by EOD.
nina: I'll be online for the canary.
sam: feature-flag patch incoming in 15m.
maya: Thanks team — appreciate the quick sync.
